drug_identity.name_ko: 트리플 항생제 안과용 제제 (네오마이신/폴리믹신 B/바시트라신 등)
drug_identity.active_ingredient: Neomycin sulfate, Polymyxin B sulfate, Bacitracin zinc (ointment) / Gramicidin (solution)
drug_identity.off_label_note: First choice for prophylactic and therapeutic antimicrobial coverage in dogs and horses for ulcerative keratitis until culture results are available.

cyp_profile.pathway_evidence: Topical ophthalmic application results in localized action; systemic absorption is minimal under normal conditions.

metabolism_and_clearance.extra_information: Aminoglycosides (Neomycin) are primarily effective against aerobic gram-negative bacteria.

organ_burden_logic.note: Topical application limits systemic burden. The primary risk is severe hypersensitivity/anaphylaxis in cats.

blood.evidence: Ophthalmic antibiotics containing neomycin and polymyxin B may cause cutaneous sensitization and anaphylaxis in cats.

heart.evidence: Rare reports of death in cats following anaphylactic reactions to neomycin/polymyxin B.

timing_profile.evidence: Acts locally on the ocular surface.

_ddi_note: Triple antibiotic ophthalmic preparations should not be mixed directly with any other ophthalmic medications. Wait 5-10 minutes between different eye medications.

dosage_list.duration_note: Apply 3 to 4 times daily until resolution.
Monitor closely for signs of hypersensitivity or anaphylaxis.
dosage_list.evidence: Commonly used but neomycin/polymyxin B pose high allergy risk in cats.

effects_and_mechanisms.common_mechanism: Neomycin interferes with 30S ribosomal subunits to inhibit protein synthesis (bactericidal). Polymyxin B increases cell membrane permeability. Bacitracin inhibits cell wall synthesis. Combination covers gram-positive and gram-negative organisms.
common_extra_effects: overgrowth of nonsusceptible organisms (e.g. fungi) with prolonged use

species_notes.dog: First choice for prophylactic and therapeutic antimicrobial coverage in ocular surface inflammatory conditions.
species_notes.cat: High sensitivity to neomycin and polymyxin B. Monitor for anaphylaxis (itching, reddening, edema of eyelids, difficulty breathing).

cat.evidence: Severe hypersensitivity and anaphylaxis risk, primarily due to neomycin or polymyxin components.

storage_and_forms.storage: Store at controlled room temperature (20°C-25°C [68°F-77°F]) away from moisture and sunlight. Do not freeze.
forms: Corticosteroid-containing Ophthalmic Ointment (e.g. with Hydrocortisone or Dexamethasone)

section_1_2_10.highlights: Prophylactic and therapeutic first choice for ulcerative keratitis in dogs/horses. Some animals (especially cats) may have severe hypersensitivity. Avoid corticosteroid versions in patients with ulcers.
section_1_2_10.indications: Topical treatment of superficial infections of the external eye, antimicrobial prophylaxis for surgeries and corneal injuries.
section_1_2_10.client_info: Cats may have severe allergic reactions; contact vet if breathing difficulty or facial swelling occurs. Wait 5-10 minutes between different medications. Do not touch the tip to any surface.
